title: Theologumena Arithmeticae (Greek)
author: Iamblichus (de Falco ed)
description: A Greek work traditionally associated with Iamblichus exploring the symbolic and philosophical meanings of numbers. It offers access to the arithmetic theology of late antiquity, where number is read as an expression of cosmic order.
editionNote: Curator-supplied PDF and EPUB from the organised ebook collection. Source text obtained from the Internet Archive (https://archive.org/details/falco-theologumena-arithmeticae-gr-lat-1922).
rights: From the curator's private collection. Publication rights for this edition are to be confirmed before public release.
